pages: Roza Kell, dark hair in a low knot, wears a moss-green work jacket and stands on the flood wall with one hand on the coping, looking out over the drowned meadow. Middle distance: a fat half-drowned hawthorn, a gate post standing in the water, a sluice paddle. Background: the still flooded upper meadow and a mill chimney beyond, hot dry August afternoon light.

Roza Kell, dark hair in a low knot, wears a moss-green work jacket and lifts a thick damp ledger down from a plank shelf, both hands under it. Middle distance: a stack of spare gate irons, a tin oil can, a hanging sluice lamp. Background: whitewashed sluice house, north light through a small window.

Corin Slee, a lean man of seventy-one with white hair, wears a brown tweed coat and holds a pen over the open water-book on the sluice-house table. Middle distance: a glass inkwell, a flat brass lamp, the sluice key on a nail. Background: bare stone sluice house, dusk, the lamp just lit.

Corin Slee, a lean man of seventy-one with white hair, wears a brown tweed coat and stands with one hand in his pocket on the flood wall, looking out over the drowned meadow. Middle distance: a spare gate iron, the coping stones, a length of chain. Background: flat brown water over sunken hedges, cold bright March morning.

Hal Teel, a man of forty-two with dark hair greying at the temples, wears a slate-blue work shirt and turns a small plain gold ring over on his open palm at a scrubbed kitchen table. Middle distance: a stoneware jug, a folded cloth, a lamp with no shade. Background: the Teel farmhouse kitchen, flat cold window light.

Hal Teel, a man of forty-two with dark hair greying at the temples, wears a slate-blue work shirt under a grey coat and stands on the doorstep, one hand on the door frame, looking back into the room. Middle distance: a worn stone step, a boot scraper, a milk churn. Background: the corner of the Teel terrace in wet weather, flat overcast light.

Bo Ashe, a broad-shouldered man of fifty-five with greying hair, wears a brown carter's coat and pulls a stiff leather glove onto his right hand beside the shafts of his cart. Middle distance: a pile of harness traces, a curry comb, a worn boot. Background: the cart yard behind the mill, flat morning light.

Fenn Ashe, a man of thirty-two with dark curly hair, wears a blue carter's smock and pushes a folded wage chit flat across a mill-office desk with one palm. Middle distance: the water-book turned sideways, an enamel cup, a rate sheet. Background: the mill office window and the yard beyond, dull overcast daylight.

Corin Slee, a lean man of seventy-one with white hair, wears a brown tweed coat and stands just inside a shut sluice-house door, the water-book held under one arm. Middle distance: a heavy sluice gate, a dead lamp, a wet coat on a hook. Background: the sluice house in early dawn, cold grey light through the doorway.

Roza Kell, dark hair in a low knot, wears a moss-green work jacket and sits on the flood wall above the tailrace with a burnt-out lamp set beside her, watching the water drop. Middle distance: a wooden rule, the tailrace coping, a gate-mark post. Background: the dark sleeping town of Tarnby, first light before sunrise.

Fenn Ashe, a man of thirty-two with dark curly hair, wears a blue carter's smock under an unbuttoned wet coat and stands in the sluice-house doorway shaking rain off his cap. Middle distance: a wet folded sheaf of paper, a chair, two muddy boots. Background: the sluice house with rain running down the small window, grey Monday afternoon.

Corin Slee, a lean man of seventy-one with white hair, wears shirtsleeves and a grey waistcoat and lays the open water-book flat on the table, one fingertip holding the page. Middle distance: a glass inkwell, a flat brass lamp, a tin cup. Background: the stone sluice house, lamplight against the dusk outside.

Corin Slee, a lean man of seventy-one with white hair, wears shirtsleeves and a grey waistcoat and squares the water-book against the table edge with both palms flat on it. Middle distance: a wooden straightedge, a stub of pen, an enamel lamp. Background: the bare sluice house, low evening light from the window.

Corin Slee, a lean man of seventy-one with white hair, wears shirtsleeves and a grey waistcoat and holds one finger down at the second column of the open book. Middle distance: a brass straightedge, an inkwell, a blunt pencil. Background: the cold sluice house in flat winter daylight, the lamp out.

Roza Kell, dark hair in a low knot, wears a moss-green work jacket and sits on a low stool, pen in hand over the open water-book pushed across the table. Middle distance: a glass inkwell, a hurricane lamp, a tin mug. Background: the sluice house with the light gone early, lamplight only.

Wenna Kell, a small woman of sixty-eight with white hair under a black headscarf, wears a brown apron over a grey dress and holds her finger on a page of the household book. Middle distance: the open book, a stoneware jug, a rush chair. Background: the sluice house on a Thursday morning, thin grey daylight at the door.

Corin Slee, a lean man of seventy-one with white hair, wears a grey waistcoat with his shirtsleeves rolled, and rests two fingers on the open book on the table. Middle distance: a flat brass lamp, a tin cup, a shut sluice-house door. Background: the stone sluice house at eight in the morning, low clear light.

Corin Slee, a lean man of seventy-one with white hair, wears a grey waistcoat and lays one flat hand on the shut water-book, squared against the table edge. Middle distance: a brass straightedge, a spilled inkwell, a lamp with its wick trimmed. Background: the sluice house window over the tailrace, high morning light.
